pages.text: Build robots in the $(item)Electronics Assembler$().$(li)$(l)geomine$() - robot uses a $(item)Geolyzer$() to find and mine only ores$(li)$(l)lumber$() - robot lumberjack$(br2)Install each with $(l)oppm install <name>$().

$(l)drone-sort$() is a drone BIOS that sorts items between waypoints. Flash it to an EEPROM and put it in the drone.$(br2)Install: $(l)oppm install drone-sort$()$(br2)The $(l)Digger$() and $(l)Builder$() loot disks are ready-made robot programs too.
